boundary: Original Python Product dispatcher + adapter + client; scripted authority HTTP

typedGoBoundaries.catalog-nonobject: CatalogResult cannot encode an array root
typedGoBoundaries.catalog-lookups-null: Malformed null catalog lookup list; typed nil slice is representable but must not be silently normalized
typedGoBoundaries.catalog-unselected-malformed: Typed LookupDescriptor emits fields omitted by the malformed descriptor
typedGoBoundaries.view-nonobject: LookupQueryResult cannot encode an array root
typedGoBoundaries.view-boolean-count: Typed page integer cannot encode bool
typedGoBoundaries.snapshot-open-object: Typed QuerySnapshot cannot preserve unknown members or missing defined fields
typedGoBoundaries.catalog-product-error: First-hop public domain error, expressible via mutation.ProductError to PublicError; replay required
typedGoBoundaries.page-product-error: Second-hop public domain error, expressible via mutation.ProductError to PublicError; replay required
